strict allowlists reject arbitrary codes, environment labels and malformed positions
bounded history retains newest events and explicitly reports dropped rows

observations: Support report v1 is a typed structured object with allowlisted environment, operation, diagnostics, source aliases, positions, current sync state and bounded omission counts.
Raw request IDs are excluded by contract and an executed regression; source aliases are scoped to one diagnostic event.
No general logging sink, cross-event source identity or distributed request tracing was established.
Roadmap 1-13 is locally implemented; original feature requirements 1-18 are distinct from roadmap stage numbers. Optional future scope and new candidate publication are separate gates.

decisions.reason: An implemented and validated local feature scope plus open publication/environment gates does not itself identify an unfinished runtime stub.
A structured sanitized report exists; unrestricted request ID logging is not a justified default change. General log sinks and full tracing remain outside this report.

limits: Static reassessment plus reused unchanged-input checks; not a new release, remote inspection or completion of the overall 72-consideration goal.
No product fields, schema changes, raw identifiers, version bump, push or publication.
